description: This file defines the ShippingEstimateWrapper class, responsible for computing shipping estimates and available shipping methods for a shopping cart in the OFBiz framework. It manages shipping-related data, interacts with other OFBiz components, and provides methods to retrieve shipping estimates and timeframes.

classes.name: ShippingEstimateWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for calculating and retrieving shipping estimates and methods for a shopping cart in OFBiz.

methods.name: getWrapper
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ShippingEstimateWrapper instance for a given shopping cart and shipping group.

methods.name: loadShippingMethods
methods.description: Loads available shipping methods based on the current shopping cart and addresses.

methods.name: loadEstimates
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for each available shipping method, considering allowances and other factors.

methods.name: loadShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves estimated shipping times for each available shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping methods.

methods.name: getAllEstimates
methods.description: Returns a map of shipping method to estimated shipping cost.

methods.name: getShippingEstimate
methods.description: Returns the shipping estimate for a specific shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimates
methods.description: Returns the list of shipping time estimates.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Returns the estimated shipping time in days for a specific shipping method.
